review_method.boundary: Read only. No item, app, or tool edits; no publication-status changes; no tests, builds, commits, pushes, or network calls. Only lane-04.json and lane-04.md were written.

rendering_findings.source_content: **Proof technique:** direct: count the $\mathfrak n^+$-fixed weight vectors of a costandard object, then split every extension by a weight argument, dualizing in the remaining case.
rendering_findings.symptom: The uppercase technique banner shows the inline TeX source literally, including dollar delimiters and \mathfrak n^+, instead of rendering the mathematical expression. The banner capitalization itself is expected styling.

optional_typography.observation: Wikilinks render as separate block lines; this is intended and was not treated as a defect.
Uppercase proof-technique banners are the expected CSS treatment; raw math within the banner is reported above.
The individually viewed tile sequences show expected overlapping crops for long items. No standalone clipping was confirmed; ordinary line wrapping and crop boundaries were not counted as clipping.

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.exact_claim: The rank-two crystallographic possibilities have Cartan integer products 0, 1, 2 or 3, corresponding angles and root-length ratios; in rank two the irreducible systems are A2, B2 ≅ C2 and G2 with three, four and six positive roots, while the reducible system is A1 ⨿ A1.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.why_warranted: The statement gives a finite classification by angle, length ratio, Cartan integers and positive-root count, and the proof explicitly lists coefficient coordinates for each case. A small comparison figure would make those geometric distinctions easy to check.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.specific_content_maps_relations_to_draw_: Show four root sets in the plane: A1 ⨿ A1 as two orthogonal pairs; A2 with six equal-length roots and simple roots at 120 degrees; B2/C2 with eight roots, the source-listed long/short length ratio 2 and angle 135 degrees; G2 with twelve roots, six positive roots at length ratio 3 and angle 150 degrees. Label chosen simple roots α1, α2 and all positive roots by the coefficient pairs enumerated in source step 5.1; include negative roots as central opposites. Keep the long/short ordering consistent with each stated Cartan pair.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.certainty: uncertain optional candidate; every root count, angle, length ratio and coefficient label comes from the source, and the theorem is already proved in prose.

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.exact_claim: In the A2 example, the α-string through β has p=0,q=1 and terms β, β+α; the α-string through α has p=2,q=0 and terms −α,0,α, with p−q=β(hα) in each case.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.why_warranted: The example compares two explicit root strings with different endpoints and verifies the string identity; a line schematic would show the index orientation and endpoint counts directly.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.specific_content_maps_relations_to_draw_: Draw a first horizontal α-direction string with marked lattice positions β (k=0) and β+α (k=1), with absent adjacent positions β−α and β+2α indicated as not roots; label p=0, q=1. Draw a second string on the α-line with positions −α, 0, α corresponding to k=−2,−1,0; label p=2, q=0. Annotate p−q=−1=β(hα) and p−q=2=α(hα). Distinguish the zero vector at the origin from a root.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.certainty: uncertain optional candidate; all positions and Cartan integer checks are explicit in the source, and the proof is complete without a diagram.
